title: Count the common improved conformal heat theorem once
statement: The three retained derivations reach the same conformal all-means/all-fields QC threshold lambda_H=(3+sqrt(3))/24; their moving leading primitive agrees after rho=2k. For proper signed-SVD coefficients a,b>=0 with C_M=a C_plus+b C_minus, the block1 tunable certificate gives Lambda_p(a,b)=[a^2(2p+1)/(1+4p-2p^2)+b^2/p]/4,0<p<1, with endpoint p=1 and permitted ROC quadratic residuals. Its conformal minimum is lambda_H. Literal rational18x18 Gram certificates at99/500 and27/100 are retained weaker history, including their all-M convex-combination extension; failed lower-coefficient searches are not lower bounds. This does not reach3/16 or settle P0/global full-Q QC.
